response.overview: This video sculpture is titled after the writer Samuel Beckett’s 1965 text, which starkly contemplates confinement and the edges of reality. A monolithic cube, evoking Minimalist art of the 1960s and 1970s, is illuminated from within by projected images of a larger-than-life human head. The subject is gradually covered with organic substances in a cycle of desecration and renewal. In Judith Barry’s words, “Such waste drops so that I might live, until, from loss to loss...my entire body falls beyond the limit.”
response.title: Imagination, dead imagine
